package handler

import (
	rules "GENRE_MODULE/game/modules/scenariorules"
)

// 成员用自己当前的连接读视图（room 的 View 做成员与连接检查）；金币是 wallet 的余额。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=memory
func handlerCoopView(m IScenarioRoomEntity, p IScenarioPlayerEntity, connection string) (rules.View, error) {
	if _, err := m.Room().View(p.ID(), connection); err != nil {
		return rules.View{}, err
	}
	s, err := rules.Decode(m.Dao().GetCoopState())
	if err != nil {
		return rules.View{}, err
	}
	seat := s.Index(p.ID())
	if seat < 0 {
		return rules.View{}, rules.ErrRule
	}
	return rules.View{Revision: s.Revision, NextSeq: s.Last[p.ID()].Command.Seq + 1, Stage: s.Stage, Cleared: s.Cleared, Claimed: s.Claimed[seat], Coins: p.Wallet().Balance()}, nil
}
